items.title: 3 Healthcare Stocks with Promising Prospects
items.summary: Personal health and wellness is one of the many secular tailwinds for healthcare companies. Players catalyzing medical advancements have benefited from elevated demand, and their momentum is only rising as the industry has posted a 24.9% gain over the past six months, beating the S&P 500 by 13.3 percentage points.
